title: Lemon Pickle
description: Heirloom sun-cured yellow lemons and whole garlic cloves steeped with powdered rock salt, roasted mustard-methi spice blend, and pungent Byadgi chilli.

steps.instruction: Wash lemons and chillies thoroughly, wipe dry with a clean cloth, ensuring zero water residue.
Cut lemons into eighths, slit chillies into halves, and peel garlic cloves.
Grind natural rock salt into powder. Add 2 palms of salt over lemons, chillies, and garlic in a clean glass/ceramic bharani jar.
Tie mouth of jar with clean cotton cloth. Set aside for 4-5 days, tossing 2-3 times daily until lemon rinds turn tender and juicy.
Dry-roast mustard, fenugreek (menthya), and hing. Coarsely crush with a mortar and pestle.
Add the roasted spice powder and red chilli powder to the cured lemons. Mix gently with a dry wooden spoon. Let mature for a few more days.

storyOrOrigin: The quintessential ceramic jar (jaadi/bharani) pickle handed down across generations, getting more medicinal and flavorful with age.
grandmasSecrets: Always use rock salt ground fresh into powder. Table iodized salt doesn't cure the rind properly.
Keep the jar mouth tied with a breathable cotton cloth; never let moisture or wet spoons touch the pickle.
